title: Resolution urging MTA to require good jobs in subway car deal
summary: The resolution calls on the Metropolitan Transportation Authority to include transparent, enforceable “good jobs” standards in its request for proposals and resulting contracts for up to 2,390 new subway cars. It also urges rolling stock manufacturers receiving large MTA contracts to sign Community Benefits Agreements with affected communities. The procurement, RFP R34262, was released March 19, 2026 as part of the MTA's $68 billion 2025-2029 Capital Plan.
